title: Cybersecurity Foundations course opens for enrolment
excerpt: A new 10-week online programme introducing security principles, safe practices and entry-level careers.
body: NYTI has launched Cybersecurity Foundations, a 10-week online programme designed for learners with basic IT skills.
The course covers security principles, threat awareness, safe practices for organisations and an overview of entry-level security careers. Successful learners receive an NYTI-certified certificate.

title: October offline intake across 7 divisions
excerpt: Classroom batches for design, accounting, electrical and hospitality programmes begin next month.
body: Authorized partners across seven divisions will begin new classroom batches in October.
Seats are limited and allocated on a first-come basis. Applicants can choose their preferred training center during enrolment.

title: 2,400 learners honoured at the National Certification Ceremony
excerpt: Graduates from 38 partner institutions received their certificates in Dhaka.
body: NYTI celebrated 2,400 graduates from 38 authorized partner institutions at this year's National Certification Ceremony.
Every certificate issued at the ceremony is independently verifiable through the NYTI verification portal.

title: Five institutions join the authorized partner network
excerpt: New partners in Barishal, Khulna and Rangpur expand access to certified training.
body: Five institutions have completed NYTI's authorization review and joined the partner network.
Each partner has been assessed for facilities, instructor qualifications and assessment integrity.

title: Youth Skills Scholarship Program now accepting applications
excerpt: Fully funded places for learners aged 18–30 from underserved communities.
body: The Youth Skills Scholarship Program offers fully funded places on selected NYTI programmes.
Applications are open to learners aged 18–30. Priority is given to applicants from underserved communities.

title: Workshop: verifying certificates for HR teams
excerpt: A free online session showing employers how to verify NYTI certificates at scale.
body: HR professionals can join a free online workshop on verifying NYTI certificates.
The session covers the public verification portal, QR codes and what each certificate status means.
